_about: Richard Stock (1569?-1626), rector of Allhallows, Bread Street: A Commentary upon the Prophecy of Malachi, with an Exercitation upon the same prophecy by Samuel Torshell (1865). Nichol's Series of Commentaries (Edinburgh: James Nichol; London: James Nisbet, general editor Thomas Smith), Princeton Seminary copy. The name check is on Stock (two words, as 'stock' alone is a common word); Torshell's part is in the same volume. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
